sections.heading: Amazon Image Requirements
sections.body:
Amazon has strict guidelines for product images. Here are the key requirements:

Main Image:

  • Pure white background (RGB 255,255,255)
  • Product fills 85% of frame
  • No text, graphics, or watermarks
  • Professional quality, no pixelation
  • Minimum 1000px on longest side (2000px+ recommended)

Additional Images:

  • Lifestyle and infographic images allowed
  • Text overlays permitted for features
  • Multiple angles encouraged

sections.heading: Main Image Best Practices
sections.body:
Your main image determines click-through rate in search results:

Fill the Frame: Maximize product visibility. Scale to 85% of image area.

Optimal Angle: Show the most recognizable, appealing view. Usually front-facing with label visible.

True White Background: Any off-white may cause listing suppression. Verify with color picker.

No Shadows: Amazon prefers floating product aesthetic for main images.

High Resolution: Enables zoom function. 2000px+ recommended.

sections.heading: Gallery Image Strategy
sections.body:
Amazon allows up to 9 images. Use them strategically:

Image 1: Main product (white background)

Image 2: Lifestyle shot in use

Image 3: Key features infographic

Image 4: Size/scale reference

Image 5: Ingredient/material detail

Image 6: Back/alternate angle

Image 7: Package contents

AI can generate images 1, 2, 4, and 6 directly. Combine with graphic design for infographics.

sections.heading: A+ Content Images
sections.body:
Enhanced Brand Content (A+ Content) has different requirements:

Module-Specific Sizes:

  • Standard: 970 x 300px to 970 x 600px
  • Comparison charts: 150 x 300px per product
  • Logo strip: 220 x 220px

Lifestyle Freedom: A+ Content allows creative lifestyle images that wouldn't work as main images.

Brand Storytelling: Use AI lifestyle scenes to create aspirational brand narratives.

sections.heading: Compliance Checklist
sections.body:
Before uploading, verify each image:

  • ☐ White background is pure white (#FFFFFF)
  • ☐ No text on main image
  • ☐ Product fills 85%+ of frame
  • ☐ Resolution is 1000px+ (2000px+ preferred)
  • ☐ No props or accessories not included
  • ☐ File size under 10MB
  • ☐ JPEG or PNG format
  • ☐ Color accuracy matches physical product

Non-compliant images risk listing suppression.

sections.heading: Conversion Optimization
sections.body:
Beyond compliance, optimize for conversions:

Test Main Images: Use Amazon's Manage Your Experiments to A/B test main images.

Lifestyle Context: Show product solving customer problems in gallery images.

Social Proof: Include UGC-style images that feel authentic.

Mobile-First: Most Amazon shopping happens on mobile. Ensure images work at small sizes.

AI-generated lifestyle images consistently outperform generic stock photos in conversion rates.
